claim: same-address and same-level-name reconnects isolate persistent distant terrain by stable world fingerprint and reject late semantic network responses without disconnecting

defects.symptom: different worlds at the same address and level name selected the same distant persistence store
defects.resolution: the modern protocol hashed seed now feeds a stable world-lifecycle persistence fingerprint; the canonical page-store and legacy v1 path identities include that fingerprint while null preserves the historical path

defects.symptom: a well-formed stale distant v2 response escaped the Netty payload handler as IllegalArgumentException and disconnected the client
defects.resolution: semantic response rejection is now nonfatal and nonpublishing, clears the correlated request ledger, sends bounded cancellation, increments fixed primitive reason counters, and rate-limits warnings; malformed wire payloads still fail closed

validation: acceptance/scenarios/terrain-same-name-different-world-reconnect.json against two isolated saved worlds with the same address and level name
